name: local-file-kit
description: Find and organize files on your PC from Claude: by name (Everything), by meaning in Korean and English (DigUp + EmbeddingGemma 2), disk usage (WizTree), duplicates and look-alike photos (Czkawka), photo metadata (ExifTool), archives (7-Zip), copies (robocopy), and previewed, undoable moves and Recycle Bin deletes.
